title: Qualify real dw.quantities source consumer on Ubuntu WSL Linux x64 net11 C#15
commitMessage: test: qualify Math quantities Linux WSL net11 consumer

contribution.summary: Compile and execute unchanged Math quantities source under Linux x64 .NET 11 via the qualified WSL host.
contribution.value: Stage a Windows-invoked WSL test that copies nine existing source files into an ignored net11/C#15 offline consumer, uses the WSL-mapped workspace to restore/build/run with Linux dotnet, and asserts runtime identity, exact rational arithmetic and dimension mismatch refusal. No published package mutation.
debtChanges: RS240 succeeded on attempt 001 after one preselection refusal; firstPassSucceeded=false and the Ubuntu WSL SDK host was qualified.
RS241 tests actual Linux execution of one source consumer; it does not qualify all thirteen Math packages, published NuGet binary compatibility, or M8 readiness.
contribution.nextAction: Use Linux evidence to plan independent released-package consumers and review remaining deployment architecture gates.
